Definition
[Generalized mixed boundary problem] 1. ch8:8.96–8.97\group ch08-generalized-solutions Let $\Gamma $ be a relatively open $C^1$ portion of $\partial \Omega $, let $ u =( u _1,\ldots , u _n)$ be the exterior unit normal on $\Gamma $, and put $\Gamma _D=\partial \Omega \setminus \Gamma $. Consider egin{equation} egin{aligned} Lu& =D_if^i+g & & ext{in }\Omega ,\ u& =\varphi _1 & & ext{on }\Gamma _D,\ Nu:=a^{ij} u _iD_ju+b^i u _i u+\sigma u& =\varphi _2 & & ext{on }\Gamma . \end{aligned} ag {8.96} \end{equation} Write $W_0^{1,2}(\Omega \cup \Gamma )$ for the closure of $C_0^1(\Omega \cup \Gamma )$ in $W^{1,2}(\Omega )$. For $\varphi _1\in W^{1,2}(\Omega )$ and $\sigma ,\varphi _2\in L^2(\Gamma )$, a generalized solution is a function $u\in W^{1,2}(\Omega )$ such that $u-\varphi _1\in W_0^{1,2}(\Omega \cup \Gamma )$ and egin{equation} \Qop (u,v)=\int _\Omega (f^iD_iv-gv)\, dx +\int _\Gamma (\varphi _2-f^i u _i-\sigma u)v\, ds ag {8.97} \end{equation} for every $v\in W_0^{1,2}(\Omega \cup \Gamma )$.
